Preprocessing stage review. No pipeline-deterministic findings are listed, so action=stop is not justified. However, a critical data-integrity inconsistency is present that must be corrected before downstream stages proceed.

CRITICAL – test_imbalance_ratio is mathematically impossible. The test split contains 7 180 samples across 9 classes. An imbalance ratio of exactly 1.0 requires every class to have an identical count, i.e. 7 180 / 9 = 797.777… samples per class, which is not an integer. Therefore no valid 9-class partition of 7 180 samples can yield an imbalance ratio of 1.0. The value is almost certainly a placeholder or a computation bug (e.g., defaulting to 1.0 when test-set class counts were never actually tallied). The profiling artefact corroborates this: test_to_train_prevalence_ratio is an empty array, meaning no per-class test counts were computed at all. The test split originates from a different clinical centre (CRC-VAL-HE-7K), making the absence of a domain-shift assessment a significant gap.

WARNING – llm_model_digest is null across all LLM-dependent artefacts (ingestion, profiling, representation plan). The exact Qwen checkpoint cannot be verified for reproducibility. The model identifier 'qwen3.8' does not match any publicly documented Qwen release name; confirm it resolves to the intended checkpoint on the Ollama instance before relying on any LLM-generated rationale.

CONSISTENT / OK – All other checks pass: (1) Split sizes (train 89 996, val 10 004, test 7 180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution exactly. (2) Train class counts sum to 89 996 and val class counts sum to 10 004. (3) Train imbalance ratio 1.633908 is consistent with max/min = 12 885 / 7 886 ≈ 1.634. (4) n_classes = 9, n_channels = 3, image shape 28×28×3 are consistent with the standard MedMNIST PathMNIST specification. (5) blank_image_fraction = 0.0, duplicate_train_samples = 0. (6) Channel means (≈0.53–0.74) and stds (≈0.12–0.18) are reasonable for H&E-stained patches in [0,1] range. (7) Augmentation plan (hflip, vflip, brightness; factor 4 → 359 984 augmented train samples) is appropriate for histopathology and the arithmetic checks out. (8) Normalization 'standardize' with train-only statistics is well-justified. (9) selected_index_sha256 values are present for all three splits. (10) subsampled = false confirms full-dataset use. (11) Package versions and seed (42) are recorded.

REQUIRED FIXES before continuing: (a) Recompute and report actual per-class test-set counts and the resulting test_imbalance_ratio; (b) Populate test_to_train_prevalence_ratio to quantify domain shift from the CRC-VAL-HE-7K centre; (c) Record a non-null llm_model_digest (SHA-256 of the checkpoint) and verify the 'qwen3.8' identifier maps to the intended model. Until (a) and (b) are resolved, the test-set distribution is unverified and any downstream evaluation on that split is unreliable.

test_to_train_prevalence_ratio is an empty array; no per-class test-set counts were computed despite the test split originating from a different clinical centre (CRC-VAL-HE-7K)
llm_model_digest is null in all LLM-dependent artefacts; exact Qwen checkpoint cannot be verified for reproducibility
llm_model identifier 'qwen3.8' does not match any publicly documented Qwen release name; verify it resolves to the intended checkpoint on the Ollama instance
Test-set class distribution is entirely unverified; downstream evaluation on the test split is unreliable until actual per-class counts are reported
